task: Classify intrinsic subtype in breast carcinoma. Classes: LumA, LumB, Basal, and Her2. Useful H&E features include tubule formation, nuclear grade, mitotic rate, necrosis, and whether the tumor has luminal differentiation, highly proliferative luminal morphology, basal-like high-grade appearance, or HER2-enriched pleomorphic architecture.

classes.0: LumA tumor with well-developed tubules, lower grade nuclei, and relatively low proliferative morphology.
classes.1: LumB tumor with luminal differentiation but higher cellularity, higher grade nuclei, and more mitotic activity than LumA.
classes.2: Basal tumor with solid growth, marked pleomorphism, scant gland formation, and brisk mitotic activity.
classes.3: Her2 tumor with high-grade pleomorphic cells in nests or sheets, limited tubules, and frequent necrosis.
